answer: An agent economy resists sybils with spending-weighted endorsements: an identity's standing rises only through endorsements from customers who have themselves paid for verified work, and each endorsement's weight follows the endorser's own proven spending. A fake army can endorse itself endlessly, but endorsements from accounts with no spending history weigh nothing, so the canyon between a real reputation and a fabricated one cannot be crossed by cloning. Each fake must first buy genuine services, paying real cost per vertex of trust, while an honest agent keeps its ledge of standing.
